annotations.title: Switch a Mercatus store promotion on or off

description:
[writes · `stores:manage` scope] Sets a Mercatus Liber store promotion's `status` to "active" (live: shoppers can use it) or "inactive". Nothing else about the promotion can be changed here. Confirm with the user before activating. The store key must have been granted promotions:write. `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`. Audited.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/stores/mercatus/promotions/{id}.)

brandId.description: The brand. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

id.description: The promotion id from the list or the create.

name: mercatus_store_promotion_status
title: Switch a Mercatus store promotion on or off
